title: Dashboard Navigation Test
description: Verify that the dashboard loads correctly and navigation between sections works

steps.description: Navigate to the Zavorth dashboard homepage
Assert that the dashboard loads with the main content area visible
Click on the chat/terminal navigation item
Assert that the chat interface section is displayed

title: Chat Interface Test
description: Verify that the chat input works and messages are sent successfully

steps.description: Navigate to the chat interface section
Type a test message into the chat input field
Assert that the typed message appears in the input field
Click the send button to submit the message
Assert that the message appears in the chat history

title: Theme Toggle Test
description: Verify that the light/dark mode theme toggle works correctly

steps.description: Assert that the theme changes between light and dark mode
